benchmark: gopurs-aff: gopurs and purust backend compilation

protocol.order: sequential runs; rotate first variant by one each measured round, starting with gopurs-js
protocol.cache: fresh generated output and no .purmeta/.cache per run; OS cache not flushed
protocol.settings: frozen production launchers, native defaults, explicit GOPURS_JS/PURUST_JS selectors; other compiler/GC overrides removed
protocol.note: gopurs prepares/monomorphizes for Go; purust uses its default Rust pipeline. These are complete backends, not identical compiler passes.
